Cookie Policy

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

This Cookie Policy explains how A.A.D Transport & Recovery uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our website. By continuing to use our website, you agree to the placement of cookies on your device in accordance with this Cookie Policy.

1. What Are Cookies?

Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help improve the user experience by remembering your preferences, enabling certain functionalities, and allowing us to analyse website traffic.

2. Types of Cookies We Use

  • Necessary Cookies: These cookies are essential for the website to function properly.
  • Performance Cookies: These cookies collect information about how visitors interact with our website, including pages visited and time spent, allowing us to improve the site.
  • Functionality Cookies: These cookies remember your preferences to enhance your browsing experience.
  • Analytical Cookies: Our website uses Google Analytics cookies to help us understand visitor interactions, such as which pages are visited most often and how long users stay on each page.

3. Google Analytics

Our website uses Google Analytics to analyse website traffic and improve site performance. Google Analytics cookies track and report user interactions, helping us understand how visitors use our site. For more information on how Google processes data, please visit Google’s Privacy Policy.

If you prefer not to be tracked by Google Analytics, you can install the Google Analytics opt-out browser add-on.

4. Managing Cookies

You can control the use of cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to view, manage, delete, and block cookies for a website. Please note that disabling cookies may affect the functionality of our website.

To learn more about cookies and how to manage them, visit www.aboutcookies.org or www.allaboutcookies.org.

5. Changes to This Cookie Policy

We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page, so please review this policy periodically to stay informed about our use of cookies.

6. Contact Us

For any questions regarding this Cookie Policy, please contact us:

A.A.D Transport & Recovery
Email: general@aadtransportrecovery.co.uk
Phone: 07771 004242

Contact Our Team Today!

Privacy Policy

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

This Privacy Policy describes how A.A.D Transport & Recovery (“we,” “us,” or “our”) collects, uses, and discloses your information when you use https://aadtransportrecovery.co.uk (the “Site”).

Information We Collect

Information You Provide to Us

When you visit or use our Site, you may provide us with certain personal information, including but not limited to:
–  e.g., name, email address, phone number.

Information We Collect Automatically

When you visit our Site, we automatically collect certain information about your device, including:
– Browser type and version
– Operating system
– IP address
– Time and date of visits
– Pages viewed

How We Use Your Information

We use the information we collect to:
– Provide and maintain our Site
– Improve and optimize our Site
– Communicate with you

Data Sharing and Disclosure

We may share your information with:
– Service providers and business partners who assist in operating our Site

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and organisational security measures to protect your information. However, please note that no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

Cookies and Tracking Technologies

We use cookies and similar tracking technologies to track activity on our Site and store certain information. You can instruct your browser to refuse all cookies or to indicate when a cookie is being sent.

Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have certain rights regarding your personal information, including:
– Right to access
– Right to rectification
– Right to erasure
– Right to restrict processing
– Right to data portability

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Privacy Policy on this page and updating the “Last updated” date.

Contact Us

If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at:
– A.A.D Transport & Recovery
– Walsall Rd, Birmingham, West Midlands, B42 1TQ
– general@aadtransportrecovery.co.uk
– 07771 004242

Contact Our Team Today!

Need breakdown and recovery support? A.A.D Transport & Recovery is here to help with roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment services.
Available 24/7

Flatbed Recovery Birmingham – Safe Vehicle Transportation

When your vehicle cannot be safely driven, flatbed recovery can provide a practical way to transport it without relying on the vehicle to complete the journey under its own power. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides flatbed recovery in Birmingham for non-running, damaged and mechanically faulty vehicles.Whether your car has broken down, been involved in an accident, developed a serious mechanical fault or needs to be transported to a garage, we can discuss the recovery requirements and suitable transportation option for your situation.Our recovery service is available 24/7 across Birmingham and surrounding areas, subject to availability.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote Get a free Quote

Tell us what's happened — we'll call you back within minutes.

What Is Flatbed Recovery?

Flatbed recovery uses a recovery vehicle with a flat loading platform. Instead of travelling on its own wheels, the vehicle is loaded onto the platform and transported to the required destination.

This method can be useful when a vehicle:

  • Will not start
  • Cannot move under its own power
  • Has accident damage
  • Has damaged wheels or tyres
  • Has a serious mechanical fault
  • Should not be driven
  • Needs transporting to a garage
  • Needs moving from one location to another

The appropriate recovery method depends on the vehicle, its condition, location and access. When you contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery, explain what has happened so the recovery requirements can be discussed before transportation is arranged.

When Do You Need Flatbed Recovery?

Not every breakdown requires a flatbed recovery vehicle. Some vehicles may be suitable for roadside assistance or another recovery method. However, flatbed transportation can be useful when a vehicle cannot safely be driven.

Non-Running Vehicles

If your vehicle will not start because of an engine, electrical or mechanical problem, it may need to be transported to a garage. Flatbed recovery provides a way to move the vehicle without requiring it to drive during the journey.

Accident-Damaged Vehicles

After an accident, a vehicle may have damage to its wheels, steering, suspension or bodywork. Even if the engine starts, the vehicle may not be safe to drive.
Suitable recovery can transport the vehicle to a garage, body shop or another agreed destination.

Serious Mechanical Faults

Major engine, transmission, steering or suspension faults can make continued driving unsuitable. Recovering the vehicle instead can help you avoid attempting to drive a vehicle that may not be safe to operate.

Damaged Wheels or Tyres

Severely damaged wheels or tyres can prevent normal driving. Depending on the vehicle and location, flatbed transportation may be an appropriate recovery option.

Flatbed Recovery for Damaged and Non-Running Vehicles

A damaged or non-running vehicle may require different recovery arrangements from a vehicle that can still drive normally.

Before arranging recovery, tell us if:

  • The vehicle starts
  • The wheels can move
  • The steering works normally
  • Any wheels or tyres are damaged
  • There is visible accident damage
  • The vehicle is blocking access
  • The vehicle is in a restricted location

This information helps us understand the situation and discuss the appropriate recovery requirements.

Flatbed recovery can be useful for vehicles affected by engine failure, electrical faults, serious mechanical problems, accident damage, damaged wheels and other faults that prevent safe driving.

Get A Quote

24/7 Flatbed Recovery in Birmingham

Vehicle problems can happen at any time. Your car may stop late at night, become damaged during a journey or develop a fault at the weekend. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides recovery support 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, subject to availability.
When contacting us, provide:
  • Your exact location
  • Vehicle make and model
  • Registration number
  • Description of the problem
  • Vehicle condition
  • Whether it starts or moves
  • Your preferred destination
  • Your exact location
  • Vehicle make and model
  • Registration number
  • Description of the problem
  • Vehicle condition
  • Whether it starts or moves
  • Your preferred destination

If your vehicle has stopped somewhere dangerous, prioritise your safety first. On motorways and high-speed roads, follow official road safety guidance and avoid moving into traffic unless it is safe. One of the common reasons for arranging flatbed recovery is transporting a vehicle to a garage. If your vehicle has broken down and cannot safely continue, you can provide the details of your preferred repair centre or another suitable destination.

When requesting recovery, tell us:

Collection location

Where is the vehicle currently located?

Vehicle details

What make and model is it?

Vehicle condition

Does it start, move or roll?

Problem

What happened before the vehicle stopped?

Destination

Where does the vehicle need to go?

Access

Professional Towing Service Birmingham – Available 24/7

Reliable Towing Service in Birmingham When You Need It
When your vehicle cannot safely continue its journey, arranging the right towing service can help you avoid further damage, unnecessary delays and added stress. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides dependable Towing Service Birmingham for drivers who need their vehicle moved safely from one location to another.
Whether your car has broken down outside your home, stopped working while you are at work, developed a mechanical problem on the roadside, or needs transporting to a garage, our team can help arrange safe and practical vehicle towing.
Our service is available 24/7, giving Birmingham drivers a reliable option when vehicle problems happen outside normal working hours. We focus on clear communication, careful vehicle handling and making the towing process as straightforward as possible.If your vehicle is no longer safe or suitable to drive, contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery to discuss your towing requirements and request a free quote.
Need a Birmingham Towing Service? Contact us today for assistance.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote Get a free Quote

Tell us what's happened — we'll call you back within minutes.

What Does a Towing Service in Birmingham Do?

A towing service helps move a vehicle when it cannot, or should not, be driven to its intended destination.

There are many reasons a driver may need towing. Your vehicle might have suffered a mechanical fault, stopped after a breakdown, been involved in an incident, or simply need transporting to a garage or another safe location.

A professional towing service can provide a safer alternative to attempting to drive a vehicle that may have a serious fault.

At A.A.D Transport & Recovery, we can help with vehicle towing and transportation requirements across Birmingham and surrounding areas. We first need to understand your location, vehicle condition and destination so we can determine the most appropriate recovery or towing solution.

If you are unsure whether your vehicle needs towing or another type of roadside assistance, simply explain the problem when you contact us. We can discuss the situation with you and help determine the next step.

When Might You Need Vehicle Towing in Birmingham?

Not every vehicle problem is the same. Sometimes a minor roadside issue can be resolved without transporting the vehicle, while other situations require the vehicle to be recovered.

You may need a Towing Service Birmingham if:

  • Your vehicle will not start
  • Your car has suffered a mechanical failure
  • The vehicle has lost power and cannot continue safely
  • Your vehicle has broken down on the roadside
  • The car needs to be taken to a garage
  • The vehicle is not suitable or safe to drive
  • Your vehicle has developed a fault away from home
  • You need a non-running vehicle transported
  • A vehicle needs moving after a roadside incident
  • You need your vehicle transported to another suitable location

If you are experiencing a serious vehicle fault, continuing to drive may make the problem worse. If you are unsure whether the vehicle is safe to drive, stop in a safe location where possible and contact a professional recovery service.

Birmingham Towing Service for Cars and Vehicles

A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides towing and vehicle transportation support for drivers across Birmingham.

A vehicle may need towing because of a breakdown, mechanical issue or another situation that prevents it from continuing its journey safely. Our aim is to make the process simple from the first conversation through to the vehicle reaching its destination.

When you contact us, useful information includes:

  • Your exact location
  • Your vehicle type
  • The vehicle's condition
  • What happened before the problem occurred
  • Whether the vehicle can move under its own power
  • Your preferred destination
  • Any immediate safety concerns

Providing these details helps us understand what type of assistance may be required.

Whether the destination is a garage, repair centre, home address or another suitable location, we can discuss the available towing or transportation options with you.

24/7 Towing Service Birmingham

Vehicle problems do not always happen during convenient hours. A breakdown can happen early in the morning, late at night, during a weekend or when you are travelling through Birmingham.

That is why A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 recovery support.

Our availability means you have a point of contact when you need towing or vehicle recovery outside normal business hours. If your vehicle has become unsafe or unable to continue, contact us with your location and details of the problem.

We will discuss your situation and help arrange the appropriate service.

If you are stopped on a busy road, always prioritise your own safety. Move to a safe place where possible and avoid standing close to moving traffic or attempting repairs in an unsafe location.

Car Towing Birmingham After a Breakdown

A breakdown can leave you unsure about what to do next, especially when the vehicle will not restart or has developed a problem while you are away from home.

Some common breakdown situations include:

01

Flat Battery or Starting Problem

If your vehicle will not start, the issue could be related to the battery, electrical system or another component. Depending on the situation, roadside assistance may be appropriate. If the vehicle cannot be safely driven, towing may be required.

02

Engine or Mechanical Fault

Unusual noises, loss of power, overheating or other serious mechanical symptoms can mean that continuing to drive is not advisable. In these situations, towing the vehicle to a garage can provide a safer option.

03

Vehicle Won't Move

If your car has stopped and cannot move under its own power, a towing or recovery solution may be required. Tell us what has happened and where the vehicle is located so we can discuss the next step.

04

Vehicle Needs to Reach a Garage

Sometimes a vehicle may start but still should not be driven because of a serious fault. Towing can allow the vehicle to be transported to a suitable garage without adding unnecessary mileage or risk.

Towing Your Vehicle to a Garage

One of the most common reasons people contact a towing company is because their vehicle needs to reach a garage.

If your car has broken down and you already have a preferred garage or repair centre, let us know the destination when requesting a quote.

We can discuss the transportation requirements based on:

  • Where the vehicle is located
  • The condition of the vehicle
  • Whether it can move
  • The type of vehicle
  • The destination
  • Any access or loading considerations

Our objective is to make vehicle transportation as straightforward as possible while handling the vehicle with care.

If you do not have a garage arranged, explain your situation when you contact us. We can discuss your available options.

Get A Quote

Emergency Towing in Birmingham

A vehicle breakdown can quickly become stressful when you are stranded somewhere unfamiliar or your car has stopped in an inconvenient location.

Emergency towing may be necessary when your vehicle cannot continue safely and needs to be moved from its current location.

For example, you may require towing if your vehicle has:

  • Suddenly stopped running
  • Developed a serious mechanical fault
  • Lost power
  • Become unsafe to drive
  • Broken down away from home
  • Been left at the roadside following a vehicle problem

When requesting Emergency Towing Birmingham, provide your exact location and explain what happened. If you are on or near a busy road, your safety should come first.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery can discuss your situation and help determine the most suitable recovery or towing option.

Call Now: 07771 004242

Towing Service Across Birmingham

Birmingham is a large and busy city, and vehicle problems can happen in many different locations. You may break down close to home, outside your workplace, in a car park, on a local road or while travelling through the city.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides breakdown and vehicle recovery support across Birmingham and surrounding areas.

Our current base is on Walsall Road, Birmingham, West Midlands, and our service is designed to support local drivers who need vehicle recovery, transportation or towing assistance.

If you are unsure whether your exact location is covered, contact us before arranging the service. We can confirm availability based on where your vehicle is located.

Why Choose A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

When your vehicle needs towing, you want the process to be clear and straightforward. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides a practical approach to vehicle recovery and transportation, with a focus on:

24/7 Availability

Vehicle problems can happen at any time. Our recovery support is available 24/7, including outside normal working hours.

Clear Communication

We aim to explain the available options clearly so you understand what happens next.

Safe Vehicle Handling

When a vehicle needs transporting, careful handling is important. We focus on moving vehicles safely and responsibly.

Local Birmingham Support

We provide breakdown, recovery and transportation services for drivers in Birmingham and surrounding areas.

Practical Recovery Solutions

Not every breakdown requires the same solution. We consider the vehicle's condition, location and destination when discussing the appropriate service.

Practical, No-Nonsense Support

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment, handled by people who do this every day.

How Our Birmingham Towing Service Works

Getting a vehicle towed does not have to be complicated.

1. Contact Our Team

Call A.A.D Transport & Recovery and explain what has happened. Tell us where your vehicle is located and what type of vehicle you have.

4. Receive a Quote

We can discuss the towing requirements and provide a quote based on your situation.

2. Tell Us About the Problem

Explain whether the vehicle has broken down, stopped completely, developed a mechanical fault or become unsafe to drive.

5. Arrange Vehicle Recovery

Once the service is agreed, the appropriate towing or recovery assistance can be arranged. Our goal is to keep the process simple and give you clear information at every stage.

3. Discuss Your Destination

Let us know where you need the vehicle taken, such as a garage, repair centre, home address or another suitable location.

What Information Should You Give a Towing Company?

When you need a Birmingham Towing Service, having the right information ready can make the conversation easier. Try to provide:

  • Your location: Give your exact location, road name or a nearby landmark.
  • Vehicle details: Tell us the make, model and approximate size of the vehicle.
  • Vehicle condition: Explain whether the vehicle starts, moves or has completely stopped.
  • Problem: Tell us what happened before the vehicle became unusable.
  • Destination: Let us know whether you want the vehicle taken home, to a garage, repair centre or another location.
  • Access information: If the vehicle is in a narrow street, underground car park or another restricted area, mention this when booking.

 

The more information you can provide, the easier it is to understand the recovery requirement.

Is Towing Safer Than Driving a Faulty Vehicle?

If a vehicle has a serious mechanical problem, continuing to drive may create additional risks or cause further damage.

For example, if the vehicle is overheating, losing power, making unusual noises or has another major fault, it may be better to stop in a safe location and arrange professional assistance rather than continuing the journey.

If you are uncertain whether your vehicle is safe to drive, contact a recovery professional and explain the symptoms.

A towing service can provide a way to move a vehicle without requiring you to drive it to a garage when driving is not appropriate.

Get A Quote

Towing Service Birmingham for Planned Vehicle Transportation

Towing is not always required because of an emergency.

There are also situations where a vehicle needs to be transported because it is not currently suitable to drive. For example, a non-running vehicle may need to be moved from one location to another or transported to a garage for inspection.

A.A.D Transport & Recovery can discuss planned vehicle transportation requirements as well as urgent recovery situations.

If you know your vehicle needs moving, contact us in advance where possible and provide the collection location, vehicle details and destination.

Call Now: 07771 004242

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

How do I arrange a towing service in Birmingham?

Contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery and provide your vehicle location, vehicle details, the problem you are experiencing and your preferred destination. We can discuss your requirements, confirm availability and provide a quote.

Do you provide towing 24 hours a day?

Yes. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides recovery support 24/7. If you need towing outside normal working hours, contact our team to discuss your situation and availability.

Can you tow a car that will not start?

Yes, vehicle towing and transportation can be arranged for vehicles that cannot continue under their own power. Tell us about the vehicle’s condition when you contact us so we can understand the recovery requirement.

Can you tow my vehicle to a garage?

Yes. If your vehicle needs to be transported to a garage or repair centre, provide the destination when requesting your quote. We can discuss the towing requirements based on your vehicle and location.

How much does towing cost in Birmingham?

The cost of towing depends on several factors, including the vehicle, collection location, destination, distance and circumstances of the recovery. Contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery with your details for a free quote based on your specific requirements.

Do you provide emergency towing in Birmingham?

Yes. We provide 24/7 breakdown and recovery support for drivers who need assistance with vehicles that cannot safely continue their journey. Contact us with your location and details so we can discuss the appropriate service.

What should I do if my car breaks down on a busy road?

First, prioritise your safety. If possible, move the vehicle to a safer location and turn on your hazard lights. Avoid standing close to moving traffic. Once you are in a safe position, contact a recovery or towing service and provide your exact location.

Can you help if I am not sure whether I need towing?

Yes. Explain the problem when you contact us. We can discuss what has happened and help you understand whether towing, vehicle transportation or another recovery service may be appropriate.

Need a Towing Service in Birmingham?

If your vehicle has broken down, stopped unexpectedly or cannot safely continue its journey, A.A.D Transport & Recovery is available to discuss your recovery requirements.

We provide Towing Service Birmingham, roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment services, with 24/7 availability for drivers who need practical support.

Whether you need a vehicle moved to a garage, transported to a safe location or recovered after a breakdown, contact our team with your location and vehicle details.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

A towing service helps move a vehicle when it cannot, or should not, be driven to its intended destination.<\/span><\/p>

There are many reasons a driver may need towing. Your vehicle might have suffered a mechanical fault, stopped after a breakdown, been involved in an incident, or simply need transporting to a garage or another safe location.<\/span><\/p>

A professional towing service can provide a safer alternative to attempting to drive a vehicle that may have a serious fault.<\/span><\/p>

At A.A.D Transport & Recovery, we can help with vehicle towing and transportation requirements across Birmingham and surrounding areas. We first need to understand your location, vehicle condition and destination so we can determine the most appropriate recovery or towing solution.<\/span><\/p>

If you are unsure whether your vehicle needs towing or another type of roadside assistance, simply explain the problem when you contact us.   • The vehicle is not suitable or safe to drive<\/span><\/li>
  • Your vehicle has developed a fault away from home<\/span><\/li>
  • You need a non-running vehicle transported<\/span><\/li>
  • A vehicle needs moving after a roadside incident<\/span><\/li>

Emergency Breakdown Recovery Birmingham

When your vehicle breaks down, you need help fast, not a long list of maybes. A.A.D Transport & Recovery provides emergency breakdown recovery across Birmingham, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.Whether you've stopped on a local road, outside your home, in a car park, or mid-journey, our team gets to you quickly and sorts out the right solution: roadside assistance, full vehicle recovery, or transport to a garage or destination of your choice.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote Get a free Quote

Tell us what's happened — we'll call you back within minutes.

24/7 Emergency Breakdown Recovery in Birmingham

Breakdowns don't wait for convenient timing. Early morning, late at night, weekends, rush hour whenever your vehicle lets you down, we're on call. A.A.D Transport & Recovery covers roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, day or night.

When you call, just tell us: 

  • Your exact location
  • Your vehicle make and model
  • What's gone wrong

We'll take it from there and get the right recovery option moving.

What Is Emergency Breakdown Recovery?

Emergency breakdown recovery covers any situation where your vehicle has stopped working or isn't safe to drive. Common causes include:

  • Engine or mechanical failure
  • Battery or electrical faults
  • Starting problems
  • Flat or damaged tyres
  • Fuel issues
  • Overheating
  • Dashboard warning lights
  • Accident damage
  • A vehicle that's simply unsafe to drive

Sometimes a quick fix at the roadside gets you back on the road. Other times, your vehicle needs to be recovered and transported to a garage, home, or another location either way, we handle it.

Get A Quote

Car Breakdown Recovery Birmingham

A broken-down car is stressful enough without confusion over what happens next. Our car breakdown recovery service in Birmingham is built to get you moving again with minimum fuss.

We recover vehicles from across the city at home, on local roads, in car parks, or wherever you've come to a stop (subject to safe access). You tell us the situation; we arrange the recovery and get your vehicle where it needs to go, safely and without delay.

Emergency Roadside Recovery

Not every breakdown means your car needs transporting.

If it's something like a starting fault that can potentially be sorted at the roadside, we'll try that first. If the vehicle still can't be made safe to drive, we move straight to recovery no unnecessary steps, no confusion about what happens next.

Vehicle Recovery to a Garage

If your vehicle needs professional repair, we'll transport it there directly. You choose the destination:

  • Your local garage
  • A repair centre
  • Your home
  • A dealership
  • Another location of your choice

This is especially useful for non-running vehicles that simply can't be driven anywhere.

Get A Quote

Breakdown Recovery for Non-Running Vehicles

A car that won't start can't just be driven onto a truck it needs proper recovery equipment, and that's exactly what we use.

To help us prepare the right equipment before we arrive, let us know:

  • Whether the engine starts
  • Whether the wheels can roll
  • Whether the vehicle is in neutral
  • Whether there's accident damage
  • Whether the vehicle is easily accessible

The more detail you give us, the faster we can get moving.

Emergency Recovery After an Accident

If you've been in a collision, safety comes first. If there's any immediate danger, call the emergency services straight away. Once you and everyone else is safe, we can recover your vehicle from the roadside and transport it to a agreed destination like:

Garage Repair Centre Home Other Place Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Breakdown Recovery Across Birmingham

A.A.D Transport & Recovery is based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, and operates 24/7 across the city and surrounding areas, including:

  • Birmingham City Centre
  • Aston
  • Erdington
  • Perry Barr
  • Handsworth
  • Harborne
  • Edgbaston
  • Selly Oak
  • Moseley
  • Kings Heath
  • Yardley
  • Sheldon
  • Sutton Coldfield
  • And surrounding areas

Not sure if we cover your exact location? Just call — we'll confirm straight away.

Breaking Down on a Busy Road

If you break down somewhere busy:

01

Step

Call 07771 004242 with your location and a brief description of the problem.

02

Step

We tell you which vehicle we're sending and an estimated arrival time.

03

Step

On motorways or high-speed roads, follow official road safety guidance and call emergency services if there's any danger

04

Step

When you call us, give your exact location, road name, direction of travel, and the nearest junction or landmark

Clear location details mean we find you faster.

Why Choose A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

24/7 Availability

We're on call around the clock breakdowns don't stick to office hours, and neither do we.

Local Birmingham Service

Based in Birmingham, covering Birmingham. You get a local team that knows the area.

Clear Communication

We talk you through what's happening and what to expect before recovery starts no jargon, no guesswork.

Vehicle Transportation

Wherever your vehicle needs to go garage, home, dealership we get it there safely.

Practical, No-Nonsense Support

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment, handled by people who do this every day.

What To Do When Your Car Breaks Down

Move to a safe position

if it's safe to do so, get the vehicle away from moving traffic.

Turn on hazard lights

warn other drivers your vehicle has stopped.

Check your surroundings

take extra care on busy roads, dual carriageways and motorways.

Call us

give us your exact location and explain what's happened.

Share your vehicle details

make, model, registration, and whether it can start or move.

Follow our instructions

we'll guide you through the rest.

How Emergency Breakdown Recovery Works

Simple, fast, and stress-free — exactly what you need in a breakdown.

  • Call us — tell us where you are and what's happened.
  • Give vehicle details — make, model, and the nature of the fault.
  • We assess the situation — roadside assistance, recovery, or transportation.
  • Recovery is arranged — we get moving straight away.
  • Your vehicle is transported — safely, to your chosen destination.
  Get A Quote

When Should You Call Emergency Breakdown Recovery?

Call us if your vehicle:

  • Won't start
  • Has stopped unexpectedly
  • Has a serious mechanical problem
  • Isn't safe to drive
  • Has been damaged in an accident
  • Needs transporting to a garage
  • Can't continue its journey
  • Is stuck in an unsuitable location

Not sure if it's safe to drive? Don't risk it — call us and we'll advise on the best next step.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

What is emergency breakdown recovery in Birmingham?

It’s assistance for vehicles that have stopped working or can’t safely continue their journey covering roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, or moving a non-running vehicle to a garage, home, or other destination.

Does A.A.D Transport & Recovery provide 24/7 breakdown recovery?

Yes — we’re available around the clock, every day of the week.

Can you recover a car that won't start?

Yes. Let us know whether the engine starts and whether the vehicle can move, and we’ll bring the right recovery equipment.

Can you take my broken-down car to a garage?

Yes, vehicle transportation to a garage or another agreed destination is one of our core services.

Do you provide roadside breakdown assistance?

Yes. Depending on the fault, we’ll try roadside assistance first, or move straight to recovery if needed.

Can you recover a vehicle after an accident?

Yes, once you’re safe. We’ll transport the vehicle to a suitable location as part of the recovery.

How quickly can a recovery vehicle arrive?

It depends on your location, traffic, and current demand. Call us with your exact location for the most accurate estimate.

Do you provide breakdown recovery outside Birmingham?

We’re based in Birmingham and cover the surrounding areas call us with your location and we’ll confirm availability.

What information should I provide when calling for recovery?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, registration, a description of the fault, and whether the vehicle can start or move. On a major road, also share the road name, direction of travel, and nearest junction or landmark.

What if I break down on a motorway?

Prioritise safety first and follow motorway breakdown guidance. Call emergency services if there’s danger. Once safe, call us with your location and vehicle details.

Need Emergency Breakdown Recovery in Birmingham?

Stopped, stranded, or just need your car moved to a garage A.A.D Transport & Recovery is here 24/7 with roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment across Birmingham and the surrounding areas.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Why Choose A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

24/7 Availability

We're on call around the clock breakdowns don't stick to office hours, and neither do we.

Local Birmingham Service

Based in Birmingham, covering Birmingham. You get a local team that knows the area.

Clear Communication

We talk you through what's happening and what to expect before recovery starts no jargon, no guesswork.

Vehicle Transportation

Wherever your vehicle needs to go garage, home, dealership we get it there safely.

Practical, No-Nonsense Support

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment, handled by people who do this every day.

What To Do When Your Car Breaks Down

Move to a safe position

if it's safe to do so, get the vehicle away from moving traffic.

Turn on hazard lights

warn other drivers your vehicle has stopped.

Check your surroundings

take extra care on busy roads, dual carriageways and motorways.

Call us

give us your exact location and explain what's happened.

Share your vehicle details

make, model, registration, and whether it can start or move.

Follow our instructions

we'll guide you through the rest.

How Emergency Breakdown Recovery Works

Simple, fast, and stress-free — exactly what you need in a breakdown.

  • Call us — tell us where you are and what’s happened.
  • Give vehicle details — make, model, and the nature of the fault.
  • We assess the situation — roadside assistance, recovery, or transportation.
  • Recovery is arranged — we get moving straight away.
  • Your vehicle is transported — safely, to your chosen destination.
 
Get A Quote

When Should You Call Emergency Breakdown Recovery?

Call us if your vehicle:

  • Won’t start
  • Has stopped unexpectedly
  • Has a serious mechanical problem
  • Isn’t safe to drive
  • Has been damaged in an accident
  • Needs transporting to a garage
  • Can’t continue its journey
  • Is stuck in an unsuitable location

Not sure if it’s safe to drive? Don’t risk it — call us and we’ll advise on the best next step.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

What is emergency breakdown recovery in Birmingham?

It’s assistance for vehicles that have stopped working or can’t safely continue their journey covering roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, or moving a non-running vehicle to a garage, home, or other destination.

Does A.A.D Transport & Recovery provide 24/7 breakdown recovery?

Yes — we’re available around the clock, every day of the week.

Can you recover a car that won't start?

Yes. Let us know whether the engine starts and whether the vehicle can move, and we’ll bring the right recovery equipment.

Can you take my broken-down car to a garage?

Yes, vehicle transportation to a garage or another agreed destination is one of our core services.

Do you provide roadside breakdown assistance?

Yes. Depending on the fault, we’ll try roadside assistance first, or move straight to recovery if needed.

Can you recover a vehicle after an accident?

Yes, once you’re safe. We’ll transport the vehicle to a suitable location as part of the recovery.

How quickly can a recovery vehicle arrive?

It depends on your location, traffic, and current demand. Call us with your exact location for the most accurate estimate.

Do you provide breakdown recovery outside Birmingham?

We’re based in Birmingham and cover the surrounding areas call us with your location and we’ll confirm availability.

What information should I provide when calling for recovery?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, registration, a description of the fault, and whether the vehicle can start or move. On a major road, also share the road name, direction of travel, and nearest junction or landmark.

What if I break down on a motorway?

Prioritise safety first and follow motorway breakdown guidance. Call emergency services if there’s danger. Once safe, call us with your location and vehicle details.

Need Emergency Breakdown Recovery in Birmingham?

Stopped, stranded, or just need your car moved to a garage A.A.D Transport & Recovery is here 24/7 with roadside recovery, vehicle transportation and vehicle assessment across Birmingham and the surrounding areas.

About A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Local Breakdown & Recovery Support in Birmingham

A.A.D Transport & Recovery is a Birmingham-based vehicle recovery company. We help drivers dealing with a breakdown, vehicle fault, or transportation need quickly, clearly, and without the runaround. Vehicle problems don't send a warning. Whether you're heading to work, driving home, passing through Birmingham, or stuck with a car that just won't start, we're the call you make to sort it out.

Our services centre on three things: roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment. From your first call to the job being done, we keep things simple and straightforward  for both urgent breakdowns and planned vehicle moves.

We're based in Birmingham, cover the city and surrounding areas, and we're available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

What We Do

Roadside Recovery

When your vehicle breaks down or becomes unsafe to drive, getting it somewhere safe is priority one. We help drivers stranded by a breakdown, fault, accident, or anything else that stops a journey in its tracks whether that means help at the roadside or transport to a garage, home, or another destination.

Learn More

Vehicle Transportation

Not every job is an emergency. Sometimes a car just needs moving because it's non-running, needs repairs, or has to get from one place to another. We handle that safely and conveniently, on your schedule.

Learn More

Vehicle Assessment

Not sure what's actually wrong with your vehicle? Our assessment service helps identify faults, defects, and concerns after a breakdown, warning light, or accident so you know exactly what's going on and what needs to happen next. If the vehicle isn't fit to drive, we'll sort recovery or transportation from there.

Learn More

Why A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

Available 24/7

Breakdowns don't check the clock. Early morning, late night, weekends, bank holidays we're on call.

Birmingham-Based Service

We're based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, and we know the city. That local knowledge means faster, more practical support for drivers across the area.

Clear Communication

We tell you what's happening with your vehicle and what comes next — no jargon, no guesswork.

Careful Vehicle Handling

Your vehicle matters. Whether it's being recovered or transported, it's handled properly, every time.

Practical Solutions

No two breakdowns are the same. We look at your actual situation and figure out the right next step — not a one-size-fits-all answer.

Our Approach to Vehicle Recovery

Simple: understand the problem, communicate clearly, and provide the right service.

When you call, we'll ask for your location, vehicle details, and what's happened. That's enough for us to work out the best way forward — whether that's checking if your non-running vehicle can roll and is accessible, or agreeing a collection point and destination for a garage transport job.

Accurate details up front mean a faster, more organised recovery.

Get A Quote

Supporting Drivers When Things Go Wrong

A breakdown is stressful enough without confusion about what to do next — especially somewhere unfamiliar, with passengers in the car, or when you're already running late.

Our job is to make the recovery side simple. Broken down on a Birmingham Road? Got a non-running vehicle stuck at home? Need something transported to a garage? Call us and we'll sort it  for both urgent and planned recovery needs.

Call Now: 07771 004242

Our Birmingham Service Area

Based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, we cover the city and surrounding areas, including:

  • Birmingham City Centre
  • Aston
  • Handsworth
  • Perry Barr
  • Erdington
  • Harborne
  • Edgbaston
  • Selly Oak
  • Moseley
  • Kings Heath
  • Yardley
  • Sheldon
  • Sutton Coldfield
  • And surrounding Birmingham areas

Not sure if we cover your postcode? Just call — we'll confirm straight away.

Our Services at a Glance

Emergency Breakdown Recovery

24/7 recovery support when your vehicle breaks down and cannot safely continue its journey.

Long-Distance Recovery

Vehicle recovery and transportation for longer journeys between Birmingham and other towns, cities or destinations.

Flatbed Recovery

Flatbed transportation for suitable non-running, damaged or specialist vehicles that require secure vehicle recovery.

Wheel-Lift Recovery

Wheel-lift recovery for suitable vehicles where part of the vehicle can be lifted for towing or transportation.

Motorcycle Recovery

Safe recovery and transportation for motorcycles following a breakdown, damage or when the motorcycle needs to be moved to another location.

Heavy-Duty Recovery

Recovery support for suitable larger vehicles that require specialist equipment and handling.

RV & Trailer Recovery

Recovery and transportation for suitable RVs and trailers, depending on their size, weight and recovery requirements.

Commercial Vehicle Towing

Towing and recovery support for suitable commercial vehicles that have broken down or need to be transported.

Accident Recovery

Recovery for vehicles that have been damaged in an accident and cannot safely continue their journey.

Breakdown Recovery

Help when your vehicle has broken down and cannot safely continue its journey.

When You May Need A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Call us if your vehicle:

  • Won't start
  • Has broken down
  • Has a mechanical or electrical fault
  • Can't safely continue driving
  • Needs moving to a garage or another location
  • Has been involved in an incident
  • Is a non-running vehicle
  • Needs a vehicle assessment

Not sure which service fits your situation? Call us and explain what's happened  we'll talk you through the options.

Our Commitment to Customers

We know people call a recovery company when something's already gone wrong. That could be a car that won't start, a fault needing sorted, or a non-running vehicle that needs moving safely.

Our focus stays the same throughout: practical support, clear communication, and careful handling  from the first call to the job being done.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

A Birmingham-based vehicle recovery company offering roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment, operating from Walsall Road, Birmingham, 24/7.

What services does A.A.D Transport & Recovery provide?

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment covering breakdowns, non-running vehicles, vehicle faults, and transport needs.

Is A.A.D Transport & Recovery available 24/7?

Yes, day or night, weekends and bank holidays included.

Where is A.A.D Transport & Recovery based?

Walsall Road, Birmingham, West Midlands, covering the city and surrounding areas.

Can you transport my vehicle to a garage?

Yes, call us to arrange collection and delivery to your garage, repair centre, home, or another destination.

Can you help if my vehicle will not start?

Yes, tell us your location and vehicle condition, and we’ll arrange the right recovery or transport option.

Do you provide vehicle assessments?

Yes, we help identify faults, defects, and concerns after a breakdown, warning light, accident, or other issue.

Do you provide both emergency and planned vehicle recovery?

Yes, urgent breakdown recovery and planned vehicle transportation, both covered.

What information should I provide when contacting you?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, registration, and a brief description of the problem. If it’s not running, let us know whether it can roll or be moved.

Which areas do you cover?

Birmingham and surrounding areas. Unsure about your postcode? Call and we’ll confirm.

Contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Need help with a breakdown, vehicle transportation, or vehicle assessment? We're available 24/7 across Birmingham and surrounding areas.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Our services centre on three things: roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment. From your first call to the job being done, we keep things simple and straightforward  for both urgent breakdowns and planned vehicle moves.

We’re based in Birmingham, cover the city and surrounding areas, and we’re available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

What We Do

Roadside Recovery

When your vehicle breaks down or becomes unsafe to drive, getting it somewhere safe is priority one. We help drivers stranded by a breakdown, fault, accident, or anything else that stops a journey in its tracks whether that means help at the roadside or transport to a garage, home, or another destination.

Learn More

Vehicle Transportation

Not every job is an emergency. Sometimes a car just needs moving because it's non-running, needs repairs, or has to get from one place to another. We handle that safely and conveniently, on your schedule.

Learn More

Vehicle Assessment

Not sure what's actually wrong with your vehicle? Our assessment service helps identify faults, defects, and concerns after a breakdown, warning light, or accident so you know exactly what's going on and what needs to happen next. If the vehicle isn't fit to drive, we'll sort recovery or transportation from there.

Learn More

Why A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

Available 24/7

Breakdowns don't check the clock. Early morning, late night, weekends, bank holidays we're on call.

Birmingham-Based Service

We're based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, and we know the city. That local knowledge means faster, more practical support for drivers across the area.

Clear Communication

We tell you what's happening with your vehicle and what comes next — no jargon, no guesswork.

Careful Vehicle Handling

Your vehicle matters. Whether it's being recovered or transported, it's handled properly, every time.

Practical Solutions

No two breakdowns are the same. We look at your actual situation and figure out the right next step — not a one-size-fits-all answer.

Our Approach to Vehicle Recovery

Simple: understand the problem, communicate clearly, and provide the right service.

When you call, we’ll ask for your location, vehicle details, and what’s happened. That’s enough for us to work out the best way forward — whether that’s checking if your non-running vehicle can roll and is accessible, or agreeing a collection point and destination for a garage transport job.

Accurate details up front mean a faster, more organised recovery.

Get A Quote

Supporting Drivers When Things Go Wrong

A breakdown is stressful enough without confusion about what to do next — especially somewhere unfamiliar, with passengers in the car, or when you’re already running late.

Our job is to make the recovery side simple. Broken down on a Birmingham Road? Got a non-running vehicle stuck at home? Need something transported to a garage? Call us and we’ll sort it  for both urgent and planned recovery needs.

Call Now: 07771 004242

Our Birmingham Service Area

Based on Walsall Road, Birmingham, we cover the city and surrounding areas, including:

  • Birmingham City Centre
  • Aston
  • Handsworth
  • Perry Barr
  • Erdington
  • Harborne
  • Edgbaston
  • Selly Oak
  • Moseley
  • Kings Heath
  • Yardley
  • Sheldon
  • Sutton Coldfield
  • And surrounding Birmingham areas

Not sure if we cover your postcode? Just call — we’ll confirm straight away.

Our Services at a Glance

Emergency Breakdown Recovery

24/7 recovery support when your vehicle breaks down and cannot safely continue its journey.

Long-Distance Recovery

Vehicle recovery and transportation for longer journeys between Birmingham and other towns, cities or destinations.

Flatbed Recovery

Flatbed transportation for suitable non-running, damaged or specialist vehicles that require secure vehicle recovery.

Wheel-Lift Recovery

Wheel-lift recovery for suitable vehicles where part of the vehicle can be lifted for towing or transportation.

Motorcycle Recovery

Safe recovery and transportation for motorcycles following a breakdown, damage or when the motorcycle needs to be moved to another location.

Heavy-Duty Recovery

Recovery support for suitable larger vehicles that require specialist equipment and handling.

RV & Trailer Recovery

Recovery and transportation for suitable RVs and trailers, depending on their size, weight and recovery requirements.

Commercial Vehicle Towing

Towing and recovery support for suitable commercial vehicles that have broken down or need to be transported.

Accident Recovery

Recovery for vehicles that have been damaged in an accident and cannot safely continue their journey.

Breakdown Recovery

Help when your vehicle has broken down and cannot safely continue its journey.

When You May Need A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Call us if your vehicle:

  • Won’t start
  • Has broken down
  • Has a mechanical or electrical fault
  • Can’t safely continue driving
  • Needs moving to a garage or another location
  • Has been involved in an incident
  • Is a non-running vehicle
  • Needs a vehicle assessment

Not sure which service fits your situation? Call us and explain what’s happened  we’ll talk you through the options.

Our Commitment to Customers

We know people call a recovery company when something’s already gone wrong. That could be a car that won’t start, a fault needing sorted, or a non-running vehicle that needs moving safely.

Our focus stays the same throughout: practical support, clear communication, and careful handling  from the first call to the job being done.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Who is A.A.D Transport & Recovery?

A Birmingham-based vehicle recovery company offering roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment, operating from Walsall Road, Birmingham, 24/7.

What services does A.A.D Transport & Recovery provide?

Roadside recovery, vehicle transportation, and vehicle assessment covering breakdowns, non-running vehicles, vehicle faults, and transport needs.

Is A.A.D Transport & Recovery available 24/7?

Yes, day or night, weekends and bank holidays included.

Where is A.A.D Transport & Recovery based?

Walsall Road, Birmingham, West Midlands, covering the city and surrounding areas.

Can you transport my vehicle to a garage?

Yes, call us to arrange collection and delivery to your garage, repair centre, home, or another destination.

Can you help if my vehicle will not start?

Yes, tell us your location and vehicle condition, and we’ll arrange the right recovery or transport option.

Do you provide vehicle assessments?

Yes, we help identify faults, defects, and concerns after a breakdown, warning light, accident, or other issue.

Do you provide both emergency and planned vehicle recovery?

Yes, urgent breakdown recovery and planned vehicle transportation, both covered.

What information should I provide when contacting you?

Your exact location, vehicle make and model, registration, and a brief description of the problem. If it’s not running, let us know whether it can roll or be moved.

Which areas do you cover?

Birmingham and surrounding areas. Unsure about your postcode? Call and we’ll confirm.

Contact A.A.D Transport & Recovery

Need help with a breakdown, vehicle transportation, or vehicle assessment? We’re available 24/7 across Birmingham and surrounding areas.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

24/7 Breakdown Recovery Birmingham: Fast, Reliable Car Recovery You Can Trust

Broken down, involved in an accident, or need a vehicle towed across the country? AAD Transport & Recovery provides breakdown recovery and car recovery across Birmingham, getting you and your vehicle moving day or night, rain or shine.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Availability

24/7, 365 days

Availability

24/7, 365 days

Availability

24/7, 365 days

Get a free Quote

Tell us what's happened — we'll call you back within minutes.

AT A GLANCE

AAD Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham, including emergency breakdown recovery, car recovery, accident recovery, flatbed and wheel-lift towing, and long-distance vehicle transport. Whatever's happened to your vehicle, call 07771 004242 for fast, professional roadside assistance anywhere in Birmingham and the West Midlands.

24/7 breakdown recovery Birmingham

A breakdown never happens at a convenient time. Whether your car has cut out on the motorway during rush hour, refused to start outside your house on a Sunday morning, or left you stranded in a supermarket car park late at night, AAD Transport & Recovery is available around the clock to help.

Our team responds quickly, communicates clearly, and handles every vehicle with care from the moment we arrive to the moment it's safely delivered to its destination.

We cover breakdowns anywhere in Birmingham, including residential streets, workplaces, retail car parks, and busy routes such as the M6, M5, M42 and A38. If you're unsure whether your car is safe to continue driving, call us and we'll advise the safest next step.

 

Car recovery Birmingham you can rely on

When you search for car recovery in Birmingham, you want a company that turns up quickly, treats your vehicle properly, and doesn't leave you guessing about cost or timing. AAD Transport & Recovery has built its reputation on exactly that.

We use the right vehicle for the job every time: wheel-lift recovery for quick, local jobs, and flatbed recovery for vehicles that need to be transported without touching the road, such as those with steering, suspension or transmission damage.

From the first phone call, we aim to give you a clear idea of arrival time, cost, and what happens next, so you're never left standing at the roadside wondering what's going on.

Get A Quote

Our Breakdown Recovery & Roadside Services

Whatever's happened to your vehicle, we provide breakdown recovery and roadside assistance to match. From a flat tyre outside your house to a motorway breakdown or long-distance transport, our Birmingham team handles it all with care and professionalism.

Emergency Breakdown Recovery

AAD Transport & Recovery offers 24/7 emergency breakdown recovery across Birmingham, responding quickly whether your engine's cut out, your car won't start, or a warning light has you worried. We cover residential streets, workplaces, car parks, and major roads like the M6, M5, M42 and A38 — just call with your location and we'll be on our way.

Learn More

Birmingham Towing

Need a vehicle towed across Birmingham? Our towing service handles cars, vans and small commercial vehicles, moving them safely to a garage, your home, or wherever you need. We use the right equipment for the job — wheel-lift for quick local jobs, flatbed for vehicles that shouldn't be dragged — so your car arrives in the same condition it left in.

Learn More

Flatbed Recovery

Flatbed recovery is the safest way to move a vehicle that can't or shouldn't be driven whether it's a low-clearance car, a vehicle with steering or transmission damage, or one that's been in an accident. We load, secure, and transport your car without it touching the ground, avoiding further damage on the journey.

Learn More

Accident Recovery

Being involved in an accident is stressful enough without worrying about your vehicle. AAD Transport & Recovery provides accident recovery services across Birmingham, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and taking it to a garage, insurance-approved bodyshop, or your chosen location. We work calmly and efficiently, understanding this is a difficult moment for you.

Learn More

Wheel-Lift Recovery

For straightforward local moves, wheel-lift recovery is a fast and efficient option. We lift the front or rear wheels off the ground and tow the vehicle safely — ideal for short-distance recovery to a nearby garage or home address.

Learn More

Long-Distance Recovery

Broken down miles from home? Bought a car from another city? AAD Transport & Recovery offers long-distance recovery across the UK, not just within Birmingham. We handle the logistics so you don't have to worry about how your vehicle gets back safely, with clear pricing agreed before we set off.

Learn More

Heavy-Duty Recovery

Larger vehicles need specialist equipment and experience. Our heavy-duty recovery service covers vans, light trucks and larger commercial vehicles across Birmingham, handled by a team trained to move bigger loads safely and legally.

Learn More

Motorcycle Recovery

Bikes need different handling to cars. Our motorcycle recovery service uses secure tie-down transport designed specifically for two wheels, so your motorbike is protected whether you've broken down, had an accident, or need it moved to a garage.

Learn More

RV & Trailer Recovery

Caravans, motorhomes and trailers present their own recovery challenges due to size and weight. We provide RV and trailer recovery across Birmingham and further afield, helping you get back on the road or safely to your destination.

Learn More

Commercial Vehicle Towing

Downtime costs businesses money. Our commercial vehicle towing service is built for fleet operators, tradespeople and delivery businesses who need vans and light commercial vehicles recovered quickly and professionally, with minimal disruption.

Learn More

Battery Services

Flat battery? We provide jump-start and battery boost services across Birmingham, diagnosing whether a jump start will get you going or whether the vehicle needs further attention.

Learn More

Tyre & Flat Tyre Services

A flat tyre shouldn't ruin your day. We offer flat tyre assistance, tyre changes, spare tyre installation and puncture repair support at the roadside, getting you moving again quickly wherever it's safe to do so.

Learn More

Fuel Delivery

Run out of fuel on the road? We offer emergency fuel delivery so you're not left stranded, bringing enough fuel to reach the nearest station safely.

Learn More

Car Lockout Service

Not every job is an emergency. We also provide planned vehicle transport services — inter-city relocation, dealership deliveries, auction vehicle collection, and careful transport for luxury and classic cars that need extra attention.

Learn More

Roadside Assistance

Beyond the specifics above, our general roadside assistance covers car lockouts, winch-outs for vehicles stuck in mud, snow, or ditches, and recovery from impound lots. Whatever situation you find yourself in, get in touch, and we'll advise the best solution.

Learn More

Vehicle Transport

Not every job is an emergency. We also provide planned vehicle transport services — inter-city relocation, dealership deliveries, auction vehicle collection, and careful transport for luxury and classic cars that need extra attention.

Learn More

Common Reasons Drivers Call Us for Recovery

No two breakdowns are the same, but most fall into a handful of familiar categories. Here are the situations we help with most often across Birmingham:

  • Car won't start at home, at work, in a car park or at the roadside
  • Flat battery, failed jump start or electrical fault
  • Flat tyre, damaged wheel or tyre blowout
  • Warning lights, limp mode or sudden loss of power
  • Overheating, coolant leaks or unusual engine noises
  • Clutch, gearbox or other mechanical faults
  • Running out of fuel or misfuelling
  • Vehicle involved in a collision and needs recovering from the scene
  • Van or commercial vehicle breakdown affecting a working day
  • Non-running vehicle that needs moving to a garage
  • Vehicle stuck after a motorway or major road fault
  • Locked out of your own car

If you're not sure exactly what's wrong, that's fine — call us, describe what's happening, and we'll talk you through whether it's safe to continue or whether recovery is the better option.

Why Choose AAD Transport & Recovery?

Choosing the right recovery company matters when your vehicle is off the road and you need someone you can trust to sort it out properly.

Available 24/7

breakdowns don't wait for office hours, and neither do we

Fast Response

Quick response times across Birmingham and the West Midlands.

Fully Insured

Experienced operators handling every vehicle with care.

Transparent Pricing

You'll know the cost before we start — no surprises.

Right Equipment

Flatbed, wheel-lift and heavy-duty vehicles for every job.

Local Knowledge

We know Birmingham's roads, so we get to you faster.

Nationwide Recovery

Long-distance recovery when you need to go further than Birmingham.

Clear Communication

From your first call to the moment your vehicle is delivered.

Breakdown Recovery Across Birmingham & Beyond

We provide breakdown recovery, car recovery and towing services throughout Birmingham, plus nationwide long-distance recovery when your vehicle needs to travel further.

Erdington Perry Barr Aston Sutton Coldfield Solihull West Bromwich Walsall Walsall Dudley

HOW IT WORKS

If you break down somewhere busy:

01

Call us

on 07771 004242 with your location and a brief description of the problem.immediately

02

We assess the job

and tell you which vehicle we're sending and an estimated arrival time.

03

We arrive and recover your vehicle

safely, whether that's a quick wheel-lift tow or full flatbed transport.

04

We take you and your vehicle

to your chosen destination — garage, home, or elsewhere.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham?

Yes. AAD Transport & Recovery operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, including emergency breakdowns at any time of day or night.

How quickly can you get to me?

Response times depend on your location and current job volume, but we prioritise getting to you as quickly as possible, especially in unsafe roadside situations. Call us directly for the fastest response.

Do you tow cars long distances, or just locally?

Both. We handle local towing within Birmingham as well as long-distance recovery anywhere in the UK.

What's the difference between flatbed and wheel-lift recovery?

Flatbed recovery loads the whole vehicle onto a platform, ideal for damaged, low-clearance or non-running vehicles. Wheel-lift recovery tows the vehicle with its wheels partially off the ground and is typically used for quicker, shorter-distance jobs.

Can you recover my vehicle after an accident?

Yes. We provide accident recovery, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and transporting it to a garage, body shop, or your preferred location.

Do you recover vans and commercial vehicles?

Yes. We offer commercial vehicle towing and heavy-duty recovery for vans and light commercial vehicles.

Can you help with motorbikes, caravans or trailers?

Yes. We provide dedicated motorcycle recovery as well as RV and trailer recovery for caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

What if I just have a flat tyre or flat battery?

We offer flat tyre assistance, spare tyre fitting, and battery jump-start services. Many of these issues can be resolved at the roadside without needing a full tow.

Do you deliver fuel if I've run out?

Yes, we provide emergency fuel delivery to get you moving again.

Can I choose the garage my car is taken to?

Yes. If your vehicle needs recovering, it can usually be taken to your garage of choice, a repair centre, your home address, or another safe destination you specify.

How much does breakdown recovery in Birmingham cost?

Pricing depends on the type of recovery, distance, and vehicle involved. Call us for a free, no-obligation quote before we begin any work.

What areas do you cover?

We cover Birmingham and the surrounding West Midlands area for local recovery, with long-distance and nationwide transport also available.

24/7 Breakdown Recovery Birmingham: Fast, Reliable Car Recovery You Can Trust

Broken down, involved in an accident, or need a vehicle towed across the country? AAD Transport & Recovery provides breakdown recovery and car recovery across Birmingham, getting you and your vehicle moving day or night, rain or shine.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

Availability

24/7, 365 days

Availability

24/7, 365 days

Availability

24/7, 365 days

Get a free Quote

Tell us what's happened — we'll call you back within minutes.

AT A GLANCE

AAD Transport & Recovery provides 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham, including emergency breakdown recovery, car recovery, accident recovery, flatbed and wheel-lift towing, and long-distance vehicle transport. Whatever’s happened to your vehicle, call 07771 004242 for fast, professional roadside assistance anywhere in Birmingham and the West Midlands.

24/7 breakdown recovery Birmingham

A breakdown never happens at a convenient time. Whether your car has cut out on the motorway during rush hour, refused to start outside your house on a Sunday morning, or left you stranded in a supermarket car park late at night, AAD Transport & Recovery is available around the clock to help.

Our team responds quickly, communicates clearly, and handles every vehicle with care from the moment we arrive to the moment it’s safely delivered to its destination.

We cover breakdowns anywhere in Birmingham, including residential streets, workplaces, retail car parks, and busy routes such as the M6, M5, M42 and A38. If you’re unsure whether your car is safe to continue driving, call us and we’ll advise the safest next step.

 

Car recovery Birmingham you can rely on

When you search for car recovery in Birmingham, you want a company that turns up quickly, treats your vehicle properly, and doesn’t leave you guessing about cost or timing. AAD Transport & Recovery has built its reputation on exactly that.

We use the right vehicle for the job every time: wheel-lift recovery for quick, local jobs, and flatbed recovery for vehicles that need to be transported without touching the road, such as those with steering, suspension or transmission damage.

From the first phone call, we aim to give you a clear idea of arrival time, cost, and what happens next, so you’re never left standing at the roadside wondering what’s going on.

Get A Quote

Our Breakdown Recovery & Roadside Services

Whatever’s happened to your vehicle, we provide breakdown recovery and roadside assistance to match. From a flat tyre outside your house to a motorway breakdown or long-distance transport, our Birmingham team handles it all with care and professionalism.

Emergency Breakdown Recovery

AAD Transport & Recovery offers 24/7 emergency breakdown recovery across Birmingham, responding quickly whether your engine's cut out, your car won't start, or a warning light has you worried. We cover residential streets, workplaces, car parks, and major roads like the M6, M5, M42 and A38 — just call with your location and we'll be on our way.

Learn More

Birmingham Towing

Need a vehicle towed across Birmingham? Our towing service handles cars, vans and small commercial vehicles, moving them safely to a garage, your home, or wherever you need. We use the right equipment for the job — wheel-lift for quick local jobs, flatbed for vehicles that shouldn't be dragged — so your car arrives in the same condition it left in.

Learn More

Flatbed Recovery

Flatbed recovery is the safest way to move a vehicle that can't or shouldn't be driven whether it's a low-clearance car, a vehicle with steering or transmission damage, or one that's been in an accident. We load, secure, and transport your car without it touching the ground, avoiding further damage on the journey.

Learn More

Accident Recovery

Being involved in an accident is stressful enough without worrying about your vehicle. AAD Transport & Recovery provides accident recovery services across Birmingham, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and taking it to a garage, insurance-approved bodyshop, or your chosen location. We work calmly and efficiently, understanding this is a difficult moment for you.

Learn More

Wheel-Lift Recovery

For straightforward local moves, wheel-lift recovery is a fast and efficient option. We lift the front or rear wheels off the ground and tow the vehicle safely — ideal for short-distance recovery to a nearby garage or home address.

Learn More

Long-Distance Recovery

Broken down miles from home? Bought a car from another city? AAD Transport & Recovery offers long-distance recovery across the UK, not just within Birmingham. We handle the logistics so you don't have to worry about how your vehicle gets back safely, with clear pricing agreed before we set off.

Learn More

Heavy-Duty Recovery

Larger vehicles need specialist equipment and experience. Our heavy-duty recovery service covers vans, light trucks and larger commercial vehicles across Birmingham, handled by a team trained to move bigger loads safely and legally.

Learn More

Motorcycle Recovery

Bikes need different handling to cars. Our motorcycle recovery service uses secure tie-down transport designed specifically for two wheels, so your motorbike is protected whether you've broken down, had an accident, or need it moved to a garage.

Learn More

RV & Trailer Recovery

Caravans, motorhomes and trailers present their own recovery challenges due to size and weight. We provide RV and trailer recovery across Birmingham and further afield, helping you get back on the road or safely to your destination.

Learn More

Commercial Vehicle Towing

Downtime costs businesses money. Our commercial vehicle towing service is built for fleet operators, tradespeople and delivery businesses who need vans and light commercial vehicles recovered quickly and professionally, with minimal disruption.

Learn More

Battery Services

Flat battery? We provide jump-start and battery boost services across Birmingham, diagnosing whether a jump start will get you going or whether the vehicle needs further attention.

Learn More

Tyre & Flat Tyre Services

A flat tyre shouldn't ruin your day. We offer flat tyre assistance, tyre changes, spare tyre installation and puncture repair support at the roadside, getting you moving again quickly wherever it's safe to do so.

Learn More

Fuel Delivery

Run out of fuel on the road? We offer emergency fuel delivery so you're not left stranded, bringing enough fuel to reach the nearest station safely.

Learn More

Car Lockout Service

Not every job is an emergency. We also provide planned vehicle transport services — inter-city relocation, dealership deliveries, auction vehicle collection, and careful transport for luxury and classic cars that need extra attention.

Learn More

Roadside Assistance

Beyond the specifics above, our general roadside assistance covers car lockouts, winch-outs for vehicles stuck in mud, snow, or ditches, and recovery from impound lots. Whatever situation you find yourself in, get in touch, and we'll advise the best solution.

Learn More

Vehicle Transport

Not every job is an emergency. We also provide planned vehicle transport services — inter-city relocation, dealership deliveries, auction vehicle collection, and careful transport for luxury and classic cars that need extra attention.

Learn More

Common Reasons Drivers Call Us for Recovery

No two breakdowns are the same, but most fall into a handful of familiar categories. Here are the situations we help with most often across Birmingham:

  • Car won’t start at home, at work, in a car park or at the roadside
  • Flat battery, failed jump start or electrical fault
  • Flat tyre, damaged wheel or tyre blowout
  • Warning lights, limp mode or sudden loss of power
  • Overheating, coolant leaks or unusual engine noises
  • Clutch, gearbox or other mechanical faults
  • Running out of fuel or misfuelling
  • Vehicle involved in a collision and needs recovering from the scene
  • Van or commercial vehicle breakdown affecting a working day
  • Non-running vehicle that needs moving to a garage
  • Vehicle stuck after a motorway or major road fault
  • Locked out of your own car

If you’re not sure exactly what’s wrong, that’s fine — call us, describe what’s happening, and we’ll talk you through whether it’s safe to continue or whether recovery is the better option.

Why Choose AAD Transport & Recovery?

Choosing the right recovery company matters when your vehicle is off the road and you need someone you can trust to sort it out properly.

Available 24/7

breakdowns don't wait for office hours, and neither do we

Fast Response

Quick response times across Birmingham and the West Midlands.

Fully Insured

Experienced operators handling every vehicle with care.

Transparent Pricing

You'll know the cost before we start — no surprises.

Right Equipment

Flatbed, wheel-lift and heavy-duty vehicles for every job.

Local Knowledge

We know Birmingham's roads, so we get to you faster.

Nationwide Recovery

Long-distance recovery when you need to go further than Birmingham.

Clear Communication

From your first call to the moment your vehicle is delivered.

Breakdown Recovery Across Birmingham & Beyond

We provide breakdown recovery, car recovery and towing services throughout Birmingham, plus nationwide long-distance recovery when your vehicle needs to travel further.

HOW IT WORKS

If you break down somewhere busy:

Call us

on 07771 004242 with your location and a brief description of the problem.immediately

and tell you which vehicle we’re sending and an estimated arrival time.

03

safely, whether that’s a quick wheel-lift tow or full flatbed transport.

04

We take you and your vehicle

to your chosen destination — garage, home, or elsewhere.

FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

Do you offer 24/7 breakdown recovery in Birmingham?

Yes. AAD Transport & Recovery operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, including emergency breakdowns at any time of day or night.

How quickly can you get to me?

Response times depend on your location and current job volume, but we prioritise getting to you as quickly as possible, especially in unsafe roadside situations. Call us directly for the fastest response.

Do you tow cars long distances, or just locally?

Both. We handle local towing within Birmingham as well as long-distance recovery anywhere in the UK.

What's the difference between flatbed and wheel-lift recovery?

Flatbed recovery loads the whole vehicle onto a platform, ideal for damaged, low-clearance or non-running vehicles. Wheel-lift recovery tows the vehicle with its wheels partially off the ground and is typically used for quicker, shorter-distance jobs.

Can you recover my vehicle after an accident?

Yes. We provide accident recovery, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and transporting it to a garage, body shop, or your preferred location.

Do you recover vans and commercial vehicles?

Yes. We offer commercial vehicle towing and heavy-duty recovery for vans and light commercial vehicles.

Can you help with motorbikes, caravans or trailers?

Yes. We provide dedicated motorcycle recovery as well as RV and trailer recovery for caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

What if I just have a flat tyre or flat battery?

We offer flat tyre assistance, spare tyre fitting, and battery jump-start services. Many of these issues can be resolved at the roadside without needing a full tow.

Do you deliver fuel if I've run out?

Yes, we provide emergency fuel delivery to get you moving again.

Can I choose the garage my car is taken to?

Yes. If your vehicle needs recovering, it can usually be taken to your garage of choice, a repair centre, your home address, or another safe destination you specify.

How much does breakdown recovery in Birmingham cost?

Pricing depends on the type of recovery, distance, and vehicle involved. Call us for a free, no-obligation quote before we begin any work.

What areas do you cover?

We cover Birmingham and the surrounding West Midlands area for local recovery, with long-distance and nationwide transport also available.

Stuck on the road? We're ready when you are.

Don’t wait it out — call AAD Transport & Recovery now for fast, reliable breakdown recovery anywhere in Birmingham, 24 hours a day.

Call Now: 07771 004242 Get A Quote

A breakdown never happens at a convenient time. Whether your car has cut out on the motorway during rush hour, refused to start outside your house on a Sunday morning, or left you stranded in a supermarket car park late at night, AAD Transport & Recovery is available around the clock to help.

Our team responds quickly, communicates clearly, and handles every vehicle with care from the moment we arrive to the moment it's safely delivered to its destination.

We cover breakdowns anywhere in Birmingham, including residential streets, workplaces, retail car parks, and busy routes such as the M6, M5, M42 and A38. If you're unsure whether your car is safe to continue driving, call us and we'll advise the safest next step.

Yes. AAD Transport & Recovery operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, across Birmingham and the surrounding areas, including emergency breakdowns at any time of day or night.

","_id":"ee07014"},{"tab_title":"How quickly can you get to me?","tab_content":"

Response times depend on your location and current job volume, but we prioritise getting to you as quickly as possible, especially in unsafe roadside situations. Call us directly for the fastest response.

","_id":"84df15b"},{"tab_title":"Do you tow cars long distances, or just locally? ","tab_content":"

Both. We handle local towing within Birmingham as well as long-distance recovery anywhere in the UK.

","_id":"dea1ce7"},{"tab_title":"What's the difference between flatbed and wheel-lift recovery? ","tab_content":"

Flatbed recovery loads the whole vehicle onto a platform, ideal for damaged, low-clearance or non-running vehicles. Wheel-lift recovery tows the vehicle with its wheels partially off the ground and is typically used for quicker, shorter-distance jobs.

","_id":"9f01fb7"},{"tab_title":"Can you recover my vehicle after an accident? ","tab_content":"

Yes. We provide accident recovery, clearing your vehicle from the scene safely and transporting it to a garage, body shop, or your preferred location.

","_id":"d7ce03c"},{"tab_title":"Do you recover vans and commercial vehicles? ","tab_content":"

Yes. We offer commercial vehicle towing and heavy-duty recovery for vans and light commercial vehicles.

","_id":"6f67734"},{"tab_title":"Can you help with motorbikes, caravans or trailers? ","tab_content":"

Yes. We provide dedicated motorcycle recovery as well as RV and trailer recovery for caravans, motorhomes and trailers.

","_id":"3257de0"},{"tab_title":"What if I just have a flat tyre or flat battery? ","tab_content":"

We offer flat tyre assistance, spare tyre fitting, and battery jump-start services. Many of these issues can be resolved at the roadside without needing a full tow.

","_id":"9ed2352"},{"tab_title":"Do you deliver fuel if I've run out? ","tab_content":"

Yes, we provide emergency fuel delivery to get you moving again.

","_id":"4824e70"},{"tab_title":"Can I choose the garage my car is taken to? ","tab_content":"

Yes. If your vehicle needs recovering, it can usually be taken to your garage of choice, a repair centre, your home address, or another safe destination you specify.

","_id":"35b5dfc"},{"tab_title":"How much does breakdown recovery in Birmingham cost? ","tab_content":"

Pricing depends on the type of recovery, distance, and vehicle involved. Call us for a free, no-obligation quote before we begin any work.
